theme: Late-autumn chicories + two make-ahead flavor bases (just you & Mike this week)

components.name: Brothy borlotti (or cannellini) bean conserva
components.ingredients: 1 lb dried borlotti or cannellini, 1 head garlic halved, few sage leaves, 1 rosemary sprig, 2 bay leaves, 1 dried chile, 1/4 cup+ extra-virgin olive oil, sea salt
components.method: Soak the beans overnight (or quick-soak: boil 2 min, rest 1 hr). Drain, cover with fresh cold water by 2 inches, add the halved garlic head, sage, rosemary, bay, chile, and a big glug of olive oil. Bring to a bare simmer and cook gently 60-90 min until creamy but intact, skimming once or twice. Salt only in the last 20 min so the skins stay tender. Cool the beans IN their liquor and store them that way - that cloudy bean brodo is the week's gold. Keeps 5 days.

components.name: Mushroom & allium confit
components.ingredients: 1.5 lb mixed mushrooms (cremini + shiitake or maitake), 2 onions or 4 shallots, 6 garlic cloves, thyme sprigs, 1/2 cup olive oil, splash sherry vinegar, salt
components.method: Slice mushrooms and alliums. In a wide pan over medium-high with plenty of olive oil, cook the mushrooms hard and undisturbed until they release their water and re-brown deeply, 20-25 min. Add onions/shallots, garlic, and thyme; drop the heat and cook low until jammy, ~15 min. Deglaze with a splash of sherry vinegar, season, and store under a film of oil. Keeps a week - an umami bomb for pasta, eggs, toast, or spooned over fish.

dinners.name: Pasta e fagioli
dinners.ingredients: Bean conserva + its brodo, a spoon of mushroom confit, ditalini or broken short pasta, parm rind, rosemary, dried chile, finishing olive oil
steps: Warm the beans with a good ladle of their brodo, a parm rind, and a rosemary sprig.
Stir in a heaping spoon of mushroom confit for depth.
Add ditalini and a little water; simmer until pasta is cooked and the whole thing is loose and brothy.
Fish out the rind, season, and finish each bowl with chili and a hard pour of olive oil.

dinners.name: Crispy-skin cod over brothy beans
dinners.ingredients: 2 skin-on cod or branzino fillets (~3/4 lb), bean conserva + brodo, radicchio/Treviso, lemon, parsley, garlic, olive oil (gremolata)
steps: Make a quick gremolata: chopped parsley, grated garlic, lemon zest, olive oil.
Warm the beans loose and brothy in a wide bowl; char wedges of radicchio in a hot pan until edges blacken.
Pat fish skin bone-dry, lightly score, and crisp skin-side down in a hot oiled pan (see technique).
Spoon beans into bowls, lay fish crisp-side up, scatter charred radicchio, and finish with gremolata and lemon.

dinners.name: Mushroom confit, white bean & egg toast
dinners.ingredients: Mushroom confit, bean conserva, eggs, sourdough, chicory/escarole for salad, lemon, olive oil
steps: Grill or toast thick sourdough and rub with a cut garlic clove.
Smash warm beans onto the toast; pile on mushroom confit.
Top with a fried or jammy egg.
Serve with a sharp chicory salad dressed in lemon and olive oil.

dinners.name: Ribollita-style bean & cavolo nero soup
dinners.ingredients: Bean conserva + brodo, cavolo nero (lacinato kale), stale sourdough, garlic, dried chile, Parmigiano, great olive oil, optional Italian sausage
steps: Soften sliced garlic and chile in olive oil (brown a crumbled sausage here first if using).
Add shredded cavolo nero and wilt, then the beans and plenty of their brodo.
Tear in chunks of stale bread and simmer until it collapses into a thick, spoon-coating soup.
Season, ladle out, and finish with grated parm and a generous pour of olive oil.

technique.name: Crisping fish skin without curling
technique.tiedTo: The crispy-skin cod - flat, shatteringly crisp skin is the whole dish. Pat the skin bone-dry and lightly score it, lay it into a hot oiled pan skin-side down, and press it flat with a spatula for the first 30-60 seconds so it can't buckle. Cook about 80% of the way through on the skin side, then flip only to finish - don't fuss with it in between.

shopping.items: 2 heads garlic, 2 onions or 4 shallots, 1.5 lb mixed mushrooms (cremini + shiitake/maitake), radicchio or Treviso, cavolo nero (lacinato kale), chicory or escarole, 2 lemons, parsley, fresh rosemary, sage, thyme, bay leaves
2 skin-on cod or branzino fillets (~3/4 lb)
eggs, Parmigiano-Reggiano (plus a rind if you can get one)
1 lb dried borlotti or cannellini beans, ditalini or short pasta, extra-virgin olive oil (a lot), dried chiles, sherry vinegar, sourdough loaf, anchovies, capers, sea salt

scaleNote: Just you and Mike this week (girls with Jen), so the quantities above feed 2 with leftovers - the batch bases are meant to carry several dinners. For the full-house weeks (6 people, 4 girls under 10): cook 2 lb dried beans and ~3 lb mushrooms, and double the fish. Keep it kid-friendly by pulling portions before the chili goes in, serving the pasta e fagioli and ribollita a touch thicker over pasta, and offering the mushroom toast as a simple egg-and-beans toast on the side.
